# ECN-2026-021 - Change notice - Machining hydraulic forging press #2

Revision: Rev C  
Plant: P1, line P1-L3  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L3-HP02

Related documents: ECN-2026-035, SB-1029, SOP-P1-L3-01

Reason for change
- Background: During routine inspection and feedback from machining operations, documentation and safety review identified a need to formally revise the operational envelope and maintenance handling instructions for Machining hydraulic forging press #2 (EQ-P1-L3-HP02). The change clarifies the system pressure limit and aligns operational references with current preventive maintenance practice and safety bulletin content.
- Safety rationale: The primary driver is to ensure all operators, maintenance technicians, and engineering staff have an unambiguous maximum hydraulic system pressure for EQ-P1-L3-HP02 to prevent overpressure events and reduce risk of component failure. This revision provides the single authorized pressure limit for the system: the system pressure limit for Machining hydraulic forging press #2 (EQ-P1-L3-HP02) is 295 bar. This value supersedes any informal or legacy references to pressure values that lack formal control.
- Process rationale: Standardizing the pressure limit reduces variability in set point configuration, pressure gauge interpretation, and calibration targets. It supports consistent procurement of pressure control components and a harmonized approach to troubleshooting pressure-related faults.

Affected items
- Equipment: EQ-P1-L3-HP02, including hydraulic power unit, pressure relief and control valves, pressure transducers, hoses, fittings, and the machine control interface.
- Documentation: SOP-P1-L3-01 must be updated to reference the authorized system pressure limit for EQ-P1-L3-HP02 and to include verification steps aligned with this change. Related change ECN-2026-035 and safety bulletin SB-1029 are cited for additional procedural and safety context and must be cross-referenced in updated materials.
- Records and labels: Pressure set point records, calibration certificates, and in-situ pressure gauge labels on EQ-P1-L3-HP02 must reflect the new limit. Maintenance logs and inspection checklists for the equipment are affected to ensure recorded readings and tolerances are evaluated against the stated system pressure limit.
- Training: Operator and maintenance training materials that reference system pressure limits or pressure-related troubleshooting for EQ-P1-L3-HP02 must be revised. Practical training sessions and assessment checklists should incorporate verification that personnel understand and can demonstrate compliance with the stated system pressure limit.

Implementation
- Scope: The implementation applies exclusively to EQ-P1-L3-HP02 and its supporting documentation and records within Plant P1, line P1-L3. No changes to other presses are authorized by this notice unless those items are specifically captured in a separate ECN.
- Procedure updates: Update SOP-P1-L3-01 to show the system pressure limit for EQ-P1-L3-HP02 as the definitive value. Add a verification step to pre-operational checks: confirm pressure displays and gauges read no greater than the system pressure limit for Machining hydraulic forging press #2 (EQ-P1-L3-HP02) is 295 bar and document the result.
- Labeling: Apply new durable decals at the hydraulic power unit and at the operator control panel stating the system pressure limit for Machining hydraulic forging press #2 (EQ-P1-L3-HP02) is 295 bar. Existing adhesive labels that state any other pressure value must be removed or obscured.
- Controls and set points: Maintenance personnel must set and lock any adjustable pressure relief or control devices so that system pressure cannot be increased above the authorized limit. Where mechanical locks or tamper-evident seals are used, documentation must record seal identifiers and the authorizing approver.
- Verification and calibration: Pressure transducers and portable pressure measuring devices used for EQ-P1-L3-HP02 must be verified against calibration records and confirmed to be within acceptable accuracy for the stated system pressure limit. Calibration certificates referenced in maintenance logs should cite the device identifier and test result; any device lacking a valid certificate must be removed from service until recalibrated.
- Acceptance criteria: Successful implementation requires that all updated documentation is published to the document control system, that labels are installed on EQ-P1-L3-HP02, and that a three step verification is completed by maintenance and operations: physical label check, control set point confirmation, and a recorded gauge reading that does not exceed the published limit. Completion of these steps must be recorded in the equipment maintenance log and attached to the ECN closure package.
- Records to keep: Maintain the following records in the equipment file: updated SOP-P1-L3-01 excerpt showing the new limit, pressure gauge calibration certificates, pressure transducer test data, label installation confirmation, control set point lock documentation, and the completion record from the verification steps. Also include cross-references to ECN-2026-035 and SB-1029 as they relate to procedural or safety updates.
- Example scenarios: For a planned maintenance task involving replacement of a pressure relief valve on EQ-P1-L3-HP02, use the new limit as the acceptance target when adjusting the replacement valve. During pre-operational start-up after maintenance, confirm that live system readings do not exceed the declared limit and record the check in the maintenance log.

Approvals
- Approval process: This ECN requires approval by responsible engineering authority, maintenance management, and operations supervision before implementation. Approvals shall be recorded in the document control system and linked to the ECN record.
- Responsibilities: Engineering is responsible for updating SOP-P1-L3-01 and coordinating label content. Maintenance is responsible for performing mechanical set point control actions, locking set points, and performing verification checks. Operations is responsible for updating operator checklists and completing operator verification of label presence and pre-operational pressure checks.
- Cross references: Implementing parties must review ECN-2026-035 and SB-1029 for related changes and safety guidance and ensure SOP-P1-L3-01 reflects both the procedural and safety context.
- Closure requirements: The ECN will be closed when all affected items are updated, required records are filed, and approvers have signed off in the document control system. The closure package must include the records listed above and a brief implementation report summarizing actions taken on EQ-P1-L3-HP02.

Document control note
- This change notice modifies the authorized operating documentation for EQ-P1-L3-HP02 and must be referenced in future maintenance and engineering actions affecting the hydraulic system. See SOP-P1-L3-01 for day to day operational steps and ECN-2026-035 and SB-1029 for supplementary instructions and safety context.
